name: pulse
description: Pulse: single `/pulse` workflow router with the `pulse-work` runtime CLI for planned, validated, reviewable software delivery

interface.longDescription: Packages one user-facing `/pulse` router for onboarding, planning, validation, execution, review, and follow-up, while `pulse-work` manages the local workgraph and runtime state.
defaultPrompt: Use `/pulse plan` and `/pulse validate` before execution.
Use `/pulse review` after execution is complete.
